title: ParaView adaptor: complete operation reference
body:
# ParaView adaptor: complete operation reference

Generated from the current installed declarations and conceptual guidance on 2026-10-10. Regenerate with `PYTHONPATH=src python3 tools/generate_paraview_guide.py` from the repository root.

645 operation identifiers. This lists every registered input, option (including nested proxy choices), declared command, output kind and coverage gap. Native selection descriptions retain their provenance in [native-context.json](../src/schemaxis/adaptors/paraview/native-context.json); the [ParaView copyright notice](../src/schemaxis/adaptors/paraview/ParaView-Copyright.txt) applies.

[Guide](paraview-guide.md) · [Shared dollar syntax](dollar-reference.md)

Examples are **syntax templates**, not native acceptance fixtures. Replace placeholder strings, upstream node IDs and data-dependent settings with appropriate real values. The small values illustrate types only; array domains, scientific intent and native compatibility require planning/inspection/execution. Options without defaults deliberately preserve native initialisation. Each option row supplies an example, including optional keys. Nested proxy examples show selection syntax; their own option tables follow.
